messages:
maya_ux: Quick spike — proposing a compact left rail + sticky breadcrumb bar that collapses into a 'path pill' when width < 960px. Sketch attached. Thoughts? :sparkles:

leo_product: Love the idea. main worry: discoverability for nested pages (e.g., model versions). how do users know where they are when the rail collapses?

nina_frontend: we can show the breadcrumb pill and on hover expand full path, or provide keyboard shortcut `g p` to open quick jump. Implementing as CSS sticky + small JS to toggle.

aditya_dev: routing note: we should preserve deep-linkable URLs. proposed pattern: `/org/:orgId/app/:appId/(models|datasets|routes)/:resourceId?view=...`. If rail collapses we still need `?panel=open` param for legacy links.

jamie_accessibility: Accessibility: ensure focus order still logical when rail collapses. The breadcrumb pill must have `aria-expanded` and `aria-label=\"Current navigation path\"`. Also color contrast of pill text fails WCAG AA at 12px — need stronger contrast or larger text.

nina_frontend: will add `role=\"navigation\"` and make focus style visible (2px solid with accessible color). For keyboard nav we can use `aria-current=\"page\"` on active crumb.

leo_product: UX nit: rename the top group from \"Models\" to \"Model registry\"? feels clearer when grouped with datasets and artifacts.

maya_ux: Agree on naming. Also thinking microcopy: top-level left rail groups get 2-line descriptions in hover tooltip rather than inline text to reduce clutter.

aditya_dev: Implementation concern: routing complexity with breadcrumbs + pinned deep-links during canary. Need to ensure back/forward history entries are grounded. Use `history.replaceState` when toggling collapse to avoid extra entries.

nina_frontend: snippet:
```
// when panel collapsed
history.replaceState({}, document.title, currentUrl + '?rail=collapsed')
```

jamie_accessibility: test plan: keyboard-only nav, screen reader label checks, contrast. I'll write a quick axe checklist and share.

maya_ux: OK let's do a small prototype. @nina, can you mock the hover tooltip + pill animation by EOD? @jamie can you run quick a11y pass once ready? :thumbsup:

nina_frontend: On it — will post demo link in this thread. :eyes:

infra-bot: deploy started for `nav-refactor/compact-rail` — build 4823.

aditya_dev: FYI, canary needs to fallback to full rail on mem-constrained hosts. We'll gate by feature flag `compactRail`.

leo_product: Perfect. Schedule a short review w/ PMs and SRE next Wed? 30 mins.

maya_ux: Added to calendar. thanks all!"
